title: Great Pyramid chambers aligned to Sirius and Orion in 10,500 BC

tellings.quote: called The King and queen's chamber that face different constellations right the Queen's chamber faces Sirius

related.note: Both say which star targets the Great Pyramid's chamber shafts point at. This telling puts Sirius on the Queen's Chamber, where the story says a Queen's Chamber shaft points at Orion.

plain: A researcher named Matt LaCroix, speaking in 2024 with podcast host Jesse Michels, says the two main rooms inside the Great Pyramid, known as the King's Chamber and the Queen's Chamber, face different parts of the sky. According to him, the Queen's Chamber faces Sirius, a bright star, and the alignments with Sirius and the Orion constellation fit the sky of about 10,500 BC. If true, it would suggest the pyramid was planned around a date thousands of years older than usually thought.
